# Gareth Matthews

> Founder & CEO of DEPARTMNT. 15+ years across culture and commerce, building
> the infrastructure — tag, platform, app — that turns physical products,
> live events and real-world moments into owned digital relationships.

Gareth Matthews is the founder and CEO of DEPARTMNT (departmnt.xyz), a
London-based company building NFC-powered connected-product infrastructure
(TapTech: Tags, Portal, Core) for brands, artists and venues. Before
DEPARTMNT he spent over a decade in artist management, brand partnerships
and live event production across music and culture.

## Site structure

- [Home](/): Profile, client list, and featured work.
- [Work](/work): Full case study index — 19 projects spanning connected
  product infrastructure (DEPARTMNT), and earlier artist management /
  brand consulting work. Each project page includes a Brief, What We Built
  and Outcome section with named clients, categories and quantified results
  where available.
- [About](/#about): Background, speaking topics, and FAQ.
- [Press](/press): Boilerplate, bio (short and medium), headshots and
  company/personal facts for media use.
- [Thoughts](https://iammrgm.substack.com/): Long-form writing. Full
  articles are published on this site first; Substack carries a teaser
  and link back.
- [Contact](/#contact): Direct enquiry form.

## Key facts

- Role: Founder & CEO, DEPARTMNT (departmnt.xyz)
- Location: London, UK
- Areas of expertise: NFC infrastructure, ticketing systems, connected
  fashion/product, brand activation, live events, artist management
- DEPARTMNT clients referenced on this site: Genesys, Atlantic Records,
  10K Projects, G-SHOCK, Crocs, Kasina, H.LLS, YOU Studio, Mulaa Joans
- Social: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Substack — linked in the site footer
